title: 長井市「焼肉 頓珍館」— 夜は焼肉、昼はとんかつと冷麺
summary: 長井市館町南の「焼肉 頓珍館（とんちんかん）」。長井で一番長く続く焼肉店で、投稿で選ばれたロースとんかつ定食（1,000円）など、昼のとんかつ・冷麺ランチも人気です。

en.title: Nagai City's "Yakiniku Tonchinkan" — Yakiniku at night, tonkatsu and cold noodles by day
en.summary: "Yakiniku Tonchinkan" in Tatemachi-minami, Nagai City. The longest-running yakiniku restaurant in Nagai, it also boasts popular lunch options featuring tonkatsu and cold noodles, such as the loin tonkatsu set (1,000 yen) featured in the post.
en.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a tonkatsu set meal and yakiniku
en.html:
This is "Yakiniku Tonchinkan," located in Tatemachi-minami, Nagai City.

The post featured the pork loin tonkatsu set meal. This is a long-established restaurant in Nagai where you can enjoy yakiniku—primarily Yonezawa and Yamagata beef—at night, and a tonkatsu set with carefully selected pork and cold noodles at lunch.

You can find the restaurant's location and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article (the restaurant is closed on Mondays).

Source: Threads post

map_query: 焼肉 頓珍館 山形県長井市館町南16-13
markdown:
長井市館町南にある「焼肉 頓珍館」です。

投稿ではロースとんかつ定食が選ばれていました。夜は米沢牛・山形牛を中心とした焼肉、昼はこだわりの豚肉を使ったとんかつ定食と冷麺のセットが楽しめる、長井で長く続く一軒です。

お店の場所・営業時間は、この記事下部の「お店の場所」からGoogleマップで確認できます（定休日は月曜とされています）。

出典: [Threadsの投稿](https://www.threads.com/@aki_special_sweet/post/DX3qkxbk01P)
